items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg0OTc5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--34df290ff4fde0c20068f1bf6100bcd14e2552f7/e0877ba5-bb31-49b1-b43a-67619e510cab.jpg)
# Welcome to **Greenwoods Big Blind and Beyond 2026**!
# 
This competition features **4BLD** as the main event and will take place right after **[FMC World 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCWorld2026)** in the morning. It is also the **first competition in the Philippines to feature two rounds of 4BLD**.

The competition includes official events such as **7x7, Clock, 3BLD, and MBLD,** with a focus on big cubes and blindfolded events. **No 3x3 event will be held**, as this competition is designed for specialists in quiet events.

Unofficial events include **Master Magic** and **Pyraminx One-Handed**. Please check the **[Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GBBB2026#74010-unofficial-events-info-registration)** tab for more details.

This competition marks the third Greenwoods competition of the year, following **[Greenwoods Clock Clash 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsClockClash2026)** and **[Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsSummerOvertime2026)**, continuing the series of uniquely themed events in the community.

We encourage all competitors and guests to review the information tabs for details on the **schedule, regulations, venue guidelines**, and **registration** to help ensure a smooth and well-organized competition.

We look forward to seeing you—join us for a day of focused, quiet solving, where blindfolds are on and every solve is all about memory and precision.

Límite de competidores: 50

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoGamingHouseOpen2026#74835-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoGamingHouseOpen2026#74836-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).

* Los competidores deben estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda, consultar a los organizadores o los delegados de la WCA.

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHBIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bacb00caed7d0c9177dc3ea7d687667b270ce30d/6i.png) English
Competitor limit: 50

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoGamingHouseOpen2026#74835-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoGamingHouseOpen2026#74836-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called.
* It is important to read all the information available on the competition's website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.
